mutations.name: unused_db_field
mutations.note: A column added to an existing model that no application code reads or writes. Detected by static ORM-column usage analysis (D-103/N).

mutations.name: backend_service_without_caller
mutations.note: A public service class no module references. Detected by static class-usage analysis (D-103/O).

mutations.name: frontend_control_without_behavior
mutations.note: A template event handler with no defined function. Detected by static Vue control-wiring analysis (D-103/P).

mutations.name: channel_aware_module_without_channel
mutations.note: Channel-aware code that bypasses the canonical Channel Registry.

mutations.name: write_only_setting
mutations.note: A setting with a real write path but no reader: saved, yet it never changes behaviour. Detected by static write/read analysis (D-100/M).

mutations.name: orphan_setting_runtime
mutations.note: Detected by the runtime dead-setting check, not a static consumer graph.
